letter_scope: A/B is independently randomized for EACH pair. Never carry these letters across pairs or into contact sheets.
winner_scope: Relative visible quality at one timestamp only; not source identity, motion smoothness, performance, or acceptance.
all_rows_inspected_with: functions.read on both individual lossless native PNGs
image_path_rule: For each row: pairs/sequence{sequence}/pair{pair}_A.png and pairs/sequence{sequence}/pair{pair}_B.png. Exact paths and hashes are enumerated in inspected-images.json.
independence_caveat: An initial overly broad allowed-rubric search preview incidentally exposed historical assessment prose/scores. These were excluded from judgments. Identity mapping was never opened; the review is identity-blind, not completely prior-assessment-naive.

defect_codes.D01: Oversized/high-left tubular support-arm silhouette and screen intrusion
defect_codes.D02: Calm coherent-sheet 66-to-67 magazine visibility/entry step; not inferred from a single still pair
defect_codes.D04: Simplified slab-like fingers, base cradle, tubular sleeve, or abrupt cuff presentation
defect_codes.D05: Shared broad/simple environment or dark weapon form/material separation
